_note: Trend-genre presets for MusicGen text prompts. bpm is the TARGET tempo: post-processing stretches the take to it so cuts land on a computed grid. 120/128 match the measured fast-template rhythm (8th note = 0.25 / 0.234 s). Prompts name genres, instruments and texture only — never artists or songs.
